name: Rhys Davies
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport started unconventionally. He initially trained as a geography teacher, but a chance encounter with a Caterham racer at a local car show ignited a passion he couldn't ignore. He volunteered at local rallies, learning the ropes of logistics from the ground up, before eventually landing a role with Caterham Academy. 

Rhys is meticulous and organized, approaching logistics with the same precision he once used to analyze weather patterns. He's known for his ability to anticipate problems before they arise, ensuring that the team always has the right equipment and support, no matter where they are racing. His loyalty to Caterham Academy is unwavering, and he's committed to helping them achieve success, one perfectly planned race at a time.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly parted on the side
physical.description: Rhys has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a detailed notebook filled with logistics schedules.
Insists on using color-coded labels for everything.
Mumbles quietly to himself while organizing equipment.
